name: JPY Coin v1
oneLiner: JPYC v1 is the legacy prepaid-payment yen token series from JPYC Inc., predating the funds-transfer-token migration to the current JPYC contracts.
collateral: Japanese-yen reserve assets held for the legacy prepaid-payment JPYC v1 token series
pegMechanism: Prepaid-payment instrument under Japan's Payment Services Act: yen deposited in advance is issued 1:1 as JPYC v1 tokens backed by JPYC Inc. yen reserves. Tokens are non-refundable to cash by design and usable only for payments and free balance transfers; new issuance ended 1 June 2025 ahead of migration to the redeemable funds-transfer-token JPYC.

mintAuthority.summary: JPYC v1 is a non-upgradeable legacy ERC-20 ('JPYC is ERC20, owned') with an owner-restricted mint(address,uint256) function; JPYC Inc. as contract owner is the sole minter against yen reserves.

controls.label: JPYC v1 Ethereum owner/minter (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: eth_getStorageAt slot 5 of 0x2370f9d504c7a6e775bf6e14b3f12846b594cd53 returned 0x94c2d94a786e1aaa07e95d084e88cd3a0680d152; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). EIP-1967 impl slot is zero (non-upgradeable).

controls.label: JPYC v1 Polygon (UChildERC20Proxy / PoS bridge)
controls.evidence: Blockscout confirms Polygon JPYC v1 (0x6ae7dfc7...) is a UChildERC20Proxy controlled by the Polygon PoS bridge predicate, not JPYC Inc. directly.

controls.label: JPYC v1 Gnosis (OmniBridge EternalStorageProxy)
controls.evidence: At Gnosis block 25295183: storage slots 6–7 of 0x417602f4fbdd471a431ae29fb5fe0a681964c11b returned 0xf6a78083ca3e2a662d6dd1703c939c8ace2e268d (EternalStorageProxy = Gnosis OmniBridge); mint on Gnosis is bridge-mediated.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: storage slot 5 returned EOA 0x94c2d94a786e1aaa07e95d084e88cd3a0680d152 as owner/minter; contract is non-upgradeable. Polygon deployment is UChildERC20Proxy (Polygon PoS bridge). Gnosis deployment is OmniBridge-controlled (EternalStorageProxy 0xf6a780...). Ethereum direct-minter EOA is JPYC Inc.'s issuer key.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JPYC v1 legacy deployments on Polygon and Gnosis use third-party bridge rails from Ethereum rather than purely issuer-native multichain issuance. The reviewed durable route is Polygon PoS plus Gnosis OmniBridge lock/mint exposure for the non-Ethereum contracts.

obituary.epitaph: A prepaid yen rail yielded to Japan's new stablecoin regime
obituary.obituary: JPYC Inc. permanently ended new issuance and exchange support for its prepaid JPYC series on June 1, 2025 as Japan's revised Payment Services Act took effect. Existing balances remain usable for the issuer's prepaid-payment services and transfers, but cannot be redeemed for cash and no longer have a primary issuance path. The separately tracked funds-transfer-token JPYC is the successor product; Pharos freezes v1 as its historical legacy series.
